_about: Streams shaped by the engines' own protocol classes at the releases named: vLLM v0.30.0 (vllm/entrypoints/generate/base/protocol.py DeltaMessage.reasoning; serve/engine/protocol.py UsageInfo, PromptTokenUsageInfo, CompletionTokenUsageInfo) and SGLang v0.5.21 (srt/entrypoints/openai/protocol.py DeltaMessage.reasoning_content, UsageInfo.reasoning_tokens default 0, PromptTokensDetails). vLLM sends prompt_tokens_details only with --enable-prompt-tokens-details and completion_tokens_details only with --reasoning-parser; SGLang sends prompt_tokens_details only with --enable-cache-report and always sends reasoning_tokens (0 when not counted). Not recorded from a live server: the night pass (tools/proxy_e2e.sh --engines) checks them against real ones.
